## Qualification boundary

ODCS import/round-trip, Bitol ODPS, and W3C DCAT remain capability-gated. Their presence in this matrix prevents an accidental public conformance claim; it does not register an adapter or authorize implementation. OpenLineage is qualified at projection/document level only and has no emission or transport claim.
